reading.reading: A  KOAN A  MAN  DECIDED  TO  GO  AND  STUDY  WITH  A  MASTER HE  WENT  TO  THE  DOOR  OF  THE  MASTER "WHO  ARE  YOU  WHO  WISHES  TO  STUDY  HERE"  ASKED  THE  MASTER THE  STUDENT  TOLD  THE  MASTER  HIS  NAME "THAT  IS  NOT  WHO  YOU  ARE,  THAT  IS  ONLY  WHAT  YOU  ARE  CALLED WHO  ARE  YOU  WHO  WISHES  TO  STUDY  HERE"  HE  ASKED  AGAIN THE  MAN  THOUGHT  FOR  A  MOMENT,  AND  REPLIED  "I  AM  A  PROFESSOR" "THAT  IS  WHAT  YOU  DO,  NOT  WHO  YOU  ARE,"  REPLIED  THE  MASTER "WHO  ARE  YOU  WHO  WISHES  TO  STUDY  HERE" CONFUSED,  THE  MAN  THOUGHT  SOME  MORE FINALLY,  HE  ANSWERED,  "I  AM  A  HUMAN  BEING" "THAT  IS  ONLY  YOUR  SPECIES,  NOT  WHO  YOU  ARE WHO  ARE  YOU  WHO  WISHES  TO  STUDY  HERE",  ASKED  THE  MASTER  AGAIN AFTER  A  MOMENT  OF  THOUGHT,  THE  PROFESSOR  REPLIED  "I  AM  A  CONSCIOUSNESS  INHABITING  AN  ARBITRARY  BODY" "THAT  IS  MERELY  WHAT  YOU  ARE,  NOT  WHO  YOU  ARE WHO  ARE  YOU  WHO  WISHES  TO  STUDY  HERE" THE  MAN  WAS  GETTING  IRRITATED "I  AM,"  HE  STARTED,  BUT  HE  COULD  NOT  THINK  OF  ANYTHING  ELSE  TO  SAY,  SO  HE  TRAILED  OFF AFTER  A  LONG  PAUSE  THE  MASTER  REPLIED,  "THEN  YOU  ARE  WELCOME  TO  COME  STUDY" AN  INSTRUCTION DO  FOUR  UNREASONABLE  THINGS  EACH  DAY

notes.title: Bearded figure above a scroll-like frame
notes.text: A central bearded human figure rises above the rectangular text frame. Spiral ornaments sit on either side near the shoulders, and the bottom of the frame has a shaded, uneven edge with curled sides. This arrangement appears on LP1-06 through LP1-09. It differs from the paired long-haired figures framing LP1-10 through LP1-13. No identity or source artwork is established here.

notes.title: Left-facing insect between dialogue and instruction
notes.text: Below the closing dialogue and its red punctuation cluster is a horizontal insect-like figure. Its head faces left and its striped wing extends right. Beneath it, an enlarged red initial and smaller red heading introduce the instruction in the known reading. Compare the left-facing profile on LP1-16; visual similarity alone does not establish exact source-image reuse.
